layout_sources: https://github.com/firefly-iii/import-configurations/blob/main/ch/raiffeisen/default.json (one header row, semicolon, six columns in this order: account IBAN, booking date, text, signed amount, balance, value date; dates "Y-m-d H:i:s.v")
https://github.com/tarioch/beancounttools (raiffeisench importer: Raiffeisen e-banking file names Konto_CH<digits>_<digits>)
notes: Raiffeisen e-banking transaction export: one header row (IBAN;Booked At;Text;Credit/Debit Amount;Balance;Valuta Date, the names e-banking writes), semicolons, the own IBAN on every line, booking and value dates as timestamps "2026-10-25 00:00:00.000", one signed amount with a dot decimal and no thousands mark, the balance after each line. No currency is named anywhere. The column roles and date form are documented; the header words, UTF-8, CRLF and newest-first order are from memory and assumed. Opening = the oldest line's balance less its amount; closing = the newest line's balance.
